title: 第15章 若有来世第16章 就想扎点什么本章由塔尼娅独家冠名
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
溙山发生地震引起山岩崩塌。
其中一块巨岩砸在缆车售票厅前，将一个即将下去的缆车砸成了饼。
令人庆幸的是，索道却没有被波及，否则整个索道上的游客都得遭殃。
更让人惊讶的是，那缆车里被砸死的七个人是毒贩，交易方和收货方都在里面。
而且这七个还是两个贩毒组织的主谋，手上沾了不少人命。
很多人都说是溙山山神显灵。
还有人把这起突发事件和溙山封禅的海市蜃楼联系起来。
以上是陈怀安后来才知道的事情。
他下山第一件事不是叫救护车，而是找了个小超市借充电宝，手机充上电打开‘电子女友’游戏，跟个没事儿的人一样坐在椅子上，旁边的张睿正满脸紧张地打120。
他觉得今天陈怀安之所以骨折他有一半的责任。
如果说，他没有讲那么过分的话，陈怀安也许不会坚持要爬溙山吧？
“让我康康我的电子女友在嘎哈。”
游戏画面刚打开。
陈怀安就被一屏幕的提示刷屏了。
【您剩余130天寿命。】
【您的电子女友‘李清然’受到小型兽潮攻击！】
【您的电子女友‘李清然’奋力厮杀中……】
【您的电子女友‘李清然’已受伤。】
【您的电子女友‘李清然’重伤！】
啥玩意儿？！

陈怀安心里一紧，就爬山那么一会儿怎么就受伤了？
凌晨那段时间怎会有兽潮袭击？
就算符合妖兽昼伏夜出的习性，但这是游戏啊，玩家不用睡觉的吗？
他赶紧把提示框全部叉掉，接着就看到了揪心的一幕。
只见那宅子几乎已经在妖兽的进攻下破碎，李清然被一群妖兽围着，周围横七竖八着妖兽的尸骸。
她半跪在血泊中，低着头，满头青丝盖住了脸，手里杵着那柄断剑，身上还穿着充值30送的新衣服，只是此刻那衣服上已经密布着大大小小的爪痕，破碎的布料后没有香艳的光景，只有血肉模糊的伤口。
【您的电子女友‘李清然’生命垂危！】
“可惜，还是没能和……前辈，见上一面……”
李清然感觉自己快死了。
她勉强抬起头，望着已经破了个洞的天花板，憔悴的脸颊上没有一丝血色。
那双空洞的眼凝视着清晨的天空，越来越黯淡，视野中的一切渐渐灰暗下去。
在世19载，回眸过往，尽是愁滋味。
父亲战死沙场，母亲被敌国的刺客下毒杀害。
本以为进入青云宗能为爹娘报仇，哪知却是从一个泥沼进入另一个泥沼。
修真界规矩森严，不准插手凡人国事。
可这些规矩只是用来拘束普通修士的枷锁。
于是她尽力提升修为，兢兢业业，想着未来凌驾于规矩之上，再慰藉天上爹娘亡魂……
content_en:
An earthquake occurred in Lushan Mountain and caused rock collapse.
One of the huge rocks smashed in front of the cable car ticket hall, smashing a cable car that was about to go down into a cake.
Fortunately, the cableway was not affected, otherwise all tourists on the cableway would have suffered.
What’s even more surprising is that the seven people killed in the cable car were drug dealers, including both the transaction party and the recipient.
Moreover, these seven are also the masterminds of two drug trafficking organizations, with many lives on their hands.
Many people say that it is the spirit of the mountain god of Mount Lu.
Some people connected this unexpected incident with the mirage of Fengshan Fengchan in Lushan Mountain.
The above is what Chen Huaian learned later.
The first thing he did when he came down the mountain was not to call an ambulance. Instead, he found a small supermarket to borrow a power bank, charged his mobile phone and opened the game "Electronic Girlfriend". He sat on the chair like a normal person. Next to him, Zhang Rui was dialing 120 with a nervous look on his face.
He felt that he was half responsible for Chen Huaian's fracture today.
If he hadn't gone too far, Chen Huaian might not have insisted on climbing Mount Lu, right?
"Let me Kang Kang my electronic girlfriend in Gaha."
The game screen just opened.
Chen Huaian was flooded with prompts on the screen.
【You have 130 days left to live. 】
[Your electronic girlfriend ‘Li Qingran’ is attacked by a wave of small beasts! 】
[Your electronic girlfriend ‘Li Qingran’ is fighting hard...]
[Your electronic girlfriend ‘Li Qingran’ has been injured. 】
[Your electronic girlfriend ‘Li Qingran’ is seriously injured! 】
What the hell? !
Chen Huaian felt nervous. How could he be injured after just climbing a mountain for a short time?
How could there be a beast attack during that early morning period?
Even if it conforms to the monster's habit of hiding during the day and coming out at night, this is a game. Don't players need to sleep?
He quickly crossed out all the prompt boxes, and then saw a heart-wrenching scene.
I saw that the house had almost been shattered by the attack of the monsters. Li Qingran was surrounded by a group of monsters, and there were corpses of monsters scattered around.
She was half-kneeling in a pool of blood, her head lowered, her face covered with black hair, holding the broken sword in her hand. She was still wearing new clothes that she received with a 30 recharge, but at the moment, the clothes were covered with large and small claw marks. There was no fragrant scene behind the broken cloth, only bloody wounds.
[Your electronic girlfriend ‘Li Qingran’ is dying! 】
"It's a pity that I still haven't been able to meet...senior..."
Li Qingran felt like he was about to die.
She reluctantly raised her head and looked at the hole in the ceiling. There was no trace of blood on her haggard cheeks.
Those empty eyes stared at the morning sky, which became increasingly bleak, and everything in his field of vision gradually became darker.
After living for 19 years, looking back at the past is filled with sadness.
His father died in battle, and his mother was poisoned and killed by enemy assassins.
I thought I could avenge my parents by entering the Qingyun Sect, but I didn't expect that I was going from one quagmire to another.
The rules of the world of cultivation are strict and you are not allowed to interfere in the affairs of mortals.
But these rules are just shackles used to restrain ordinary monks.
So she tried her best to improve her cultivation and work conscientiously, thinking that in the future she would be above the rules and comfort the souls of her parents in heaven...
